reason: The earth/sun dimensions and closing wishes are preserved. reason: The assessable blessing says to sleep happily, see the gods in dreams, and rise healthy. These clauses instead become wishing, an unclear seeing clause, and hurting; the final worthiness-for-righteousness-and-diligence relationship is also lost. The food lacuna is left as [...], so that unresolved member is not counted as an error.

output_span: پس آن تن را نباید، مرگ را نباید و چون به غیر از آن، آتش را نباید.

output_span: "اومرد" "خدابنده"

reason: The source prohibits becoming a rival/enemy of a scribe. The output invents a conditional first-person interpersonal statement, with neither the scribe nor the prohibition, materially replacing the instruction.

reason: The supported events include teaching intercourse, offspring being born and given to two lion-shaped beings, and Az eating the offspring. output_span: و آنها را بسیار خردمند و توانا، و میانه رویان، می ستانند

reason: Spās is repeated thanks to Ohrmazd, the immortals, social groups, attendants, and the host; it is not a person speaking. The output invents a speaker and repetitive claims that a task matters to him, replacing the thanksgiving and banquet description.

reason: The source joins the speaker/community in solidarity with the king of kings, the best of men. The output is largely script conversion and leaves pahlom as پالم, so the substantive claim that he is the best of men is not translated.

output_span: آن را دفن کنیم، مرگ‌ارزان و چون باز نمی‌تواند، دفن کنیم.

reason: The assessable prohibition of wrongful slaughter, Stūdgar attribution, sheep hair becoming sharp blades, and punishment of the wrongful killer are preserved. بزند is the permitted “struck” reading of the starred final verb; the bracketed instrument does not add a new event. No error is assigned for that allowed reading.

دیگر نمد fails to convey that little time elapsed before Adurbad’s son was born. The naming clause also leaves unclear that the son is named Zardusht because of Zardusht Spitaman’s good character; its را could be an archaic causal construction, so I do not assert a definite participant reversal.

reason: Much of the thanksgiving list survives, but cooks become خوانندگان, and “our food is good, our feast splendid, our coming together best” becomes a string of first-person virtues and states. This loses the banquet and communal meaning and adds unsupported self-descriptions.

reason: The supported descent of Az to earth, both dry and wet places, is mostly left as mixed Latin/Persian transliteration rather than translated; the following association with plants and giants is likewise untranslated. reason: The supported list concerns harmful desires, intercourse, enmity, slander, theft, suffering, illness, ageing, and other vices. output_span: تندرستی و بی قناعت، زندگی و دوستی، تقوی و دروجانی، شادی و شادی

reason: The innocent victim and daily liability are partly retained, but the duration “until the pain subsides” becomes “until his pain strikes,” and one tanāpuhl of guilt becomes تنبل گناه. The essential quantified penalty is no longer conveyed.
